name: The Warrior's Path
summary: Rorian the Dayseeker sends you to Blademaster Ren in Thendal Village. She offers young warriors instruction and discipline to defend their people.

sections.title: A Summons to the Watchtower
sections.body:
After restoring balance nearby, you return to Rorian the Dayseeker in Thendal Village. The village blademaster has noticed you, and Rorian gives you a crumpled note written by Ren herself. She asks you to come to her directly.

Ren waits in the village watchtower, high above the settlement. From there, she watches the island's borders and the recruits who may one day defend them.

sections.title: The Mantle of Protection
sections.body: Inside the watchtower, Blademaster Ren teaches you that combat takes more than brute strength. A warrior must lead, endure, and protect as the world grows more uncertain. Ren pledges to guide you as you hone your skills. Her rigorous training prepares you for the greater dangers threatening your home.

faq.q: Who sends me to find Blademaster Ren?
faq.answer: After you finish work in Thendal Village, Rorian the Dayseeker directs you to Blademaster Ren. Ren asked Rorian to send you to her watchtower when you returned.

faq.q: Where can I find Blademaster Ren?
faq.answer: Blademaster Ren waits inside the watchtower in Thendal Village on Zephras Isle. She watches over the village and trains novice combatants.
The Crumpled Note is Blademaster Ren's personal summons, delivered by Rorian. It asks you to read it and report to the Thendal Village watchtower for martial training.

faq.q: What does Blademaster Ren teach young warriors?
faq.answer: Blademaster Ren teaches vigilance, leadership, and protection. Warriors need the will to stand between danger and their people as the world shifts and dangers mount.

faq.q: Is this quest required for warrior training on Zephras Isle?
aliases: do i have to do this
faq.answer: This introduces you to Blademaster Ren, your class trainer in Thendal Village, and shows where to return for martial techniques.

faq.q: What does Ren mean by 'may the winds guide you'?
aliases: may the winds guide you meaning
faq.answer: Ren's blessing reflects the culture of Zephras Isle. It wishes travelers safe passage, focus, and fortune in unfamiliar and dangerous lands.

angles.text: As a warrior, you begin your martial education in Thendal Village with Blademaster Ren as your mentor.
